name: phd-application-intelligence-assistant
description: PhD Application Intelligence Assistant — discover, verify and track funded PhD opportunities; prepare application documents with user control.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w extension
